fields.description: The box Redis runs on. Its Network is the one whose gateways this store serves.
fields.label: Machine

fields.description: The frappe service account's own keypair on the box, generated by Setup. The private half never leaves it.
fields.label: Frappe Public Key

fields.description: From the Machine, as of this doc's last save. Where the gateways dial and Redis binds — both read the Machine live.
fields.label: Private IP

fields.description: The VPC the box is in, from the Machine as of this doc's last save. Code reads the Machine live.
fields.label: Network

fields.description: When a Projection tick last confirmed this store holds the desired state, through any of its writers: stamped with the tick's read time on every in-sync check and every successful push, never on failure. The next tick rebuilds only the key buckets saved since it; blank, it rebuilds all. Goes stale = no writer is reachable or every push is rejected; the failed Pathway Sync rows say why.
fields.label: Last Synced At

fields.description: Redis requirepass. Minted, never typed: clear it and save to rotate, then Setup this store and Deploy Agent on each of its gateways.
fields.label: Redis Password

fields.description: Object in the weights bucket. Restore uses a store's latest — this one's, or the Terminated store this box replaces.
fields.label: Last Backup Key

fields.description: Vector pushes this box's host metrics to the Region's datum. Untick on a machine whose provider already does (an Atlas machine runs Pilot); logs ship either way. Takes effect at the next Install/Update Vector or daily refresh.
fields.label: Ship Host Metrics

fields.description: Set once Vector has been installed on this box (Setup chains it; Install Vector for an older box). It pushes logs, and host metrics when ticked, to the Region's datum; its token is refreshed daily.
fields.label: Vector Setup
